title: neisosperma lifuanum
intro: Neisosperma lifuanum, commonly known as the Fijian sandalwood, is a plant species native to the Pacific island of Fiji. The Fijian sandalwood is prized for its essential oils, which have been found to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and protect the skin and mucous membranes. The therapeutic actions of Neisosperma lifuanum include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antiviral and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of the Fijian sandalwood include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
